result.summary: Found 1 visual defect: the delivery-time metadata under Tokumaru Ramen Bar has overlapping text, making it unreadable.

issues.description: Under 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar', the metadata line has colliding text: '25–30 min' overlaps 'delivery', rendering as garbled '25–30delivery · Ramen' so the delivery time is illegible.
issues.suggestion: Fix the text layout so '25–30 min delivery · Ramen' renders with proper spacing, or wrap/truncate the line so characters no longer overlap.
